entities.summary: Michael Detlef Stich is a German former professional tennis player. He was ranked world No. 2 in men's singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP), achieved in 1993, and No. 9 in men's doubles, achieved in 1991. Stich won 18 ATP Tour-level singles titles, including the 1991 Wimbledon Championships, as well as the 1993 ATP Tour World Championships and the 1992 Grand Slam Cup. He also won ten doubles titles, including the men's doubles title at the 1992 Wimbledon Championships, partnering John McEnroe, and the gold medal in men's doubles 1992 Barcelona Olympics, partnering Boris Becker.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Michael Stich's achievements in men's singles and doubles tennis earned him a world No. 2 ranking and 18 ATP Tour-level singles titles, including Wimbledon Championships. His partnership with John McEnroe at the 1992 Wimbledon Championships contributed to his success.
